notes: «[8/164] رجال الكشي:» is a reference number and the title of the cited book (Kashshi's Rijal): the source is known only by its title (rule 11); the compiler is not a transmitter
«جميل بن دراج و غيره»: «غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter (rule 8)
«قلت لأبي الحسن الأول» — the asker is the narrator; the Imam answers: the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2)
